NEUTROPENIA
Patients with neutropenia are at risk of infection from pyogenic organisms
including Staphylococcus aureus, streptococci, Gram-negative bacilli,
Pseudomonas aeruginosa, candida, and certain filamentous fungi, most notably
Aspergillus and the zygomycetes.  The risk is inversely related to the absolute
neutrophil count (ANC), the disease or condition associated with neutropenia,
duration of neutropenia, and the presence of other host defense defects or
underlying diseases.
